# infrawrench_billing_profile (Resource)

Reusable invoice settings that `infrawrench_managed_account` customers are assigned to with `billing_profile_id`: who invoices are addressed to, who receives them, the invoice currency, payment terms, tax lines, remittance details and numbering.

**The profile wins where it sets a field, and each customer fills the gaps**: leave `legal_name` unset and every customer's own name heads its invoices. Recipients are the union of the customer's contact email and `to_emails`.

Only draft invoices follow an edit. Approval writes a resolved copy of the profile onto the invoice, so a new bank account or tax rate reaches the next invoice and never an issued one.

Deleting a profile is refused while live customers are assigned to it; Terraform destroys dependent managed accounts first, which retires them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "infrawrench_billing_profile" "eu" {
  name       = "EU customers"
  legal_name = "Northwind Trading GmbH"
  address    = "Hauptstrasse 1\n10115 Berlin"
  tax_id     = "DE123456789"
  po_number  = "PO-778"

  # The customer's own contact email still receives every invoice.
  to_emails = ["ap@northwind.example"]
  cc_emails = ["receivables@fabrikam.example"]

  currency           = "EUR"
  payment_terms_days = 30
  tax_rates = [
    { name = "VAT", rate = 19 },
  ]

  invoice_number_prefix = "EU"
  invoice_number_start  = 100

  bank_account_name = "Fabrikam Cloud Ltd"
  iban              = "GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32"
  bic               = "WESTGB2L"

  footer = "Fabrikam Cloud Ltd, registered in England and Wales."
  logo   = "data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/logo.png")}"
}

resource "infrawrench_managed_account" "northwind" {
  name               = "Northwind Trading"
  contact_email      = "ap@northwind.example"
  billing_currency   = "EUR"
  billing_profile_id = infrawrench_billing_profile.eu.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) What the profile is called in pickers, 1–120 characters, unique in the organization. Not printed on invoices.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Postal address printed under the legal name, 1–1000 characters. Unset leaves each customer's billing address.
- `bank_account_name` (String) Name on the bank account, 1–120 characters.
- `bank_account_number` (String, Sensitive) Account number for banking systems without IBANs, 1–64 characters. Masked in the audit log.
- `bank_name` (String) Bank name, 1–120 characters.
- `bank_routing_number` (String) Sort code, ABA routing number or BSB, 1–64 characters.
- `bic` (String) SWIFT/BIC code, 8 or 11 upper-case letters and digits, e.g. `WESTGB2L`.
- `cc_emails` (Set of String) Addresses that receive a copy of every invoice, in lower case. At most 20. Each address gets its own message, so nobody's address is shown to anyone else.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 code in upper case, e.g. `EUR`. When set, invoices for every assigned customer are issued in this currency instead of the customer's `billing_currency`; spend in other currencies converts through `infrawrench_exchange_rate`.
- `footer` (String) Printed at the bottom of every page of the PDF, 1–2000 characters: terms, a registration number, a thank-you.
- `iban` (String, Sensitive) IBAN, upper case and grouped in fours as a bank prints it, e.g. `GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32`; its check digits are verified by the API. Masked to its last four characters in the organization's audit log.
- `invoice_number_includes_year` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`: `INV-2026-0001`, the sequence restarting each year of the period end. `false` gives `INV-0001` and one sequence for ever.
- `invoice_number_prefix` (String) Invoice number prefix, 1–16 letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Defaults to `INV`. Profiles sharing a prefix share a sequence.
- `invoice_number_start` (Number) The lowest sequence number issued, 1–999999999, for continuing a sequence from another system. Defaults to 1.
- `legal_name` (String) The legal entity invoices are addressed to, 1–200 characters. Unset leaves each customer's own name.
- `logo` (String) A PNG or JPEG `data:` URL of at most 100 KB, printed at the top of the PDF, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("logo.png")}"`. Interlaced and 16-bit PNGs and CMYK JPEGs are refused by the API.
- `payment_terms_days` (Number) Net N days from the issue date, 0–365; the invoice prints the due date it gives. 0 is due on receipt; unset prints no due date.
- `po_number` (String) Purchase-order reference printed on every invoice, 1–64 characters.
- `remittance_instructions` (String) Free-text payment instructions printed under the bank details, 1–2000 characters.
- `tax_id` (String) The addressee's tax ID or VAT number, 1–64 characters.
- `tax_rates` (Attributes List) Taxes added to every invoice as their own lines, at most 5. Each is charged on the same converted subtotal (they do not compound) and rounded to the currency's minor unit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tax_rates))
- `to_emails` (Set of String) Addresses invoices are emailed to **in addition to** each customer's contact email, in lower case. At most 20.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned profile id. Use it with `terraform import`.

<a id="nestedatt--tax_rates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tax_rates`

Required:

- `name` (String) Printed on the line, e.g. `VAT`, 1–40 characters.
- `rate` (Number) Percent, 0–100, at most four decimal places.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is in the --json output of `infrawrench invoices profiles`.
terraform import infrawrench_billing_profile.example 3c4d5e6f-7a8b-4c9d-8e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
```
